title: Recap: participles in *-ó/-ő*, and *el nem évülő*

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: You know present participles in *-ó/-ő* from B1 Unit 6. *El nem évülő* is one with *nem* between the preverb and the participle: a crime that never lapses. In Hungarian law, genocide, crimes against humanity and war crimes are *el nem évülő bűncselekmények*.

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: The principle of *egyetemes joghatóság* (universal jurisdiction) means that in some cases a country's courts may try the gravest international crimes wherever they were committed. How far it reaches is disputed.

sections.title: Patterns in Context
rows: A népirtás és az emberiesség elleni bűntettek el nem évülő bűncselekmények.
Genocide and crimes against humanity are crimes that never lapse.
Az egyetemes joghatóság szerint az elkövető a tett helyétől függetlenül felelősségre vonható.
According to universal jurisdiction, the perpetrator can be held to account wherever the act was committed.
A polgári lakosságot fegyveres konfliktusban is védeni kell.
The civilian population must be protected in armed conflict too.
